paragraphs.text:
The hot bullet pierces the wind-walker’s heart. It doubles over 
and staggers away, brushing trees from its path. You remember 
from the area’s myths that the wind-walker will die if its icy 
heart is melted. Your lucky shot must have placed the creature 
in fear of its unnatural life.

Norman and Sylvia approach, blinking back sleep. You snap 
an  order  to  strike  the  camp. You  must  evacuate  the  area  as 
quickly as possible.
